title: Breaks Labeling _in situ_ and sequencing \(BLISS)
protocol: Place the coverslips in a 10 cm dish.
Cover the coverslips with 5 ml PLL solution.
Gently shake the dishes for 15 min.
Aspirate the PLL solution and transfer it into a 15 ml tube.
Wash the coverslips three times with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Wash the coverslips once with ethanol 70%.
Air-dry the coverslips.
Place the desired number of PLL-coated coverslips into a 24-well cell culture plate.
Dispense a cell suspension freshly prepared in 1× PBS into each well.
Let the cells sediment onto the coverslip for 10 min at room temperature.
Slowly add one volume of PFA 8% in 1× PBS equal to the volume of cell suspension added before onto the coverslip.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Rinse the coverslips twice with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Store the samples in 1× PBS at 4 °C or proceed to permeabilization.
Coat a 24-well cell culture plate with PDL.
Seed approximately 1.25×10^5 HEK 293T cells per well.
Grow cells for 16-18 hours until they reach 60–70% confluence.
Transfect cells according to the preferred protocol.
Aspirate the medium and wash the cells with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Add 0.5 ml of PFA 4% in 1× PBS to each well at room temperature.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse the plate twice with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Store the plate in 1× PBS at 4 °C or proceed to permeabilization.
Cut the biopsy into small pieces and transfer them into a 15 ml tube containing PFA 4% in 1× PBS.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature while rotating.
Add glycine 2 M to obtain a final concentration of 125 mM.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Wash the tissue fragments twice with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Immerse the tissue fragments in sucrose 15% on a rotator overnight at 4 °C.
Immerse the tissue fragments in sucrose 30% on a rotator at 4 °C until they sink to the bottom of the tube.
Embed the tissue fragments in OCT and quickly freeze them at –20 °C before cryosectioning.
Section the block into 30 μm slices, mounting them onto microscope slides.
Air-dry the sections for 60 min at room temperature.
Store the sections at 4 °C or proceed to permeabilization.
Cut the biopsy into small pieces and transfer them into a 2 ml tube containing 1-1.5 ml of NIB buffer.
Incubate for 15-40 min at room temperature, pipetting the suspension up and down every 5 min until the tissue fragments become transparent.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the nuclei in 200-500 μl of 1× PBS at room temperature.
Dispense 100-200 μl of the nuclei suspension onto a 13 mm PLL-coated coverslip.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Slowly add one volume of PFA 8% in 1× PBS equal to the volume of nuclei suspension added before onto the coverslip.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Rinse the coverslips twice with 1× PBS at room temperature.
Store the samples in 1× PBS at 4 °C or proceed to permeabilization.
Briefly rinse the sample in 1× PBS at room temperature.
Incubate the sample in LB1 for 1h at 4 °C.
Briefly rinse the sample in 1× PBS at room temperature.
Exchange to LB2 and incubate for 1 h at 37 °C.
Wash the samples.
Proceed to _in situ_ blunting.
Exchange to 1× PBS at room temperature.
Incubate for 1–2 min at room temperature.
Repeat wash in 1× PBS at room temperature.
Exchange to 1× CutSmart® buffer at room temperature.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Repeat twice the equilibration in CutSmart® buffer.
Dispense a blunting mix on Parafilm M®: Nuclease-free water, Blunting buffer, BSA, dNTPs, and Blunting enzyme mix.
Place the coverslip on top of the blunting mix solution with cells facing downwards.
Seal the dish with Parafilm M®.
Incubate for 1 h at room temperature.
Exchange to 1× CutSmart® buffer at room temperature.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Repeat twice the equilibration in CutSmart® buffer.
Dispense 50 µl of A-tailing mix using the NEBNext dA-Tailing Module on Parafilm M®.
Place a coverslip on top of the A-tailing mix solution with cells facing downwards.
Seal the dish with Parafilm M®.
Incubate samples for 30 min at 37 °C.
Remove the blunting/A-tailing mix and add 1× CutSmart® buffer at room temperature.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Repeat twice the wash in 1× CutSmart® buffer.
Exchange to 1× T4 Ligase buffer.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Dispense 50 µl of ligation mix on Parafilm M® placed in a Petri dish containing tissue presoaked in distilled water.
Place the coverslips on top of the ligation mix solution with cells facing downwards.
Seal the dish with Parafilm M®.
Remove the ligation mix and add HSW buffer at room temperature.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37°C, shaking.
Repeat exchange to fresh HSW buffer and incubation at 37°C 3–5 times.
Exchange to 1× PBS at room temperature.
Incubate for 1-2 minutes at room temperature.
Exchange to nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 1-2 minutes at room temperature.
Scrape the cells off the coverslips using a sterile cell scraper.
Transfer the solution into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® RNA/DNA LoBind tube.
Incubate the solution for 16–18 h in a thermo-shaker at 55 °C, shaking at 800 rpm.
Purify the extracted DNA using silica-based columns or standard phenol-chloroform and isopropanol precipitation protocols.
Elute DNA in nuclease-free TE buffer.
Measure DNA concentration and then dilute DNA in TE buffer to the recommended concentration for sonication instrument use.
Sonicate DNA aiming to achieve a mean fragment size of 300–500 bp using Bioruptor® Plus or similar devices as described.
Pre-warm AMPure XP beads for 30 min at room temperature.
Add a 0.8× ratio of AMPure XP bead suspension to the extracted DNA.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up-down 5-6 times.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
With the sample on the magnetic stand, add 200 μl ice-cold EtOH 80%.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat once the wash in ice-cold EtOH 80%.
Air-dry the beads for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 10 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Transfer 8 μl of the cleared solution into a 0.5 ml Eppendorf RNA/DNA LoBind tube.
Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Place the extracted DNA samples in the speedVac instrument with the heat temperature set on medium.
Centrifuge for 20 min.
Keep 8.5 μl of concentrated DNA.
Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Store samples at –20 °C until _in vitro_ transcription.
In a 0.5 ml Eppendorf® RNA/DNA LoBind tube, prepare the following mix:
Add sonicated genomic DNA (7.5 μl).
Pipette rNTPs mix (8 μl).
Mix T7 polymerase buffer 10× (2 μl).
Add T7 polymerase (2 μl).
Pipette RiboSafe RNase Inhibitor (0.5 μl).
Incubate the mixture for 14 h at 37 °C in a thermocycler with lid set at 70 °C.
Add 1 μl of DNase I, RNase-free to the IVT product.
Incubate the mix for 15 min at 37 °C.
Pre-warm Agencourt RNAClean XP beads for 30 min at room temperature.
Transfer the IVT product into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® RNA/DNA LoBind tube.
Bring up the volume to 30 μl with nuclease-free water.
Add a 1.8× ratio of RNAClean XP beads suspension to the IVT product.
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
With the sample still on the magnetic stand, add 200 μl of freshly prepared EtOH 80%.
Incubate at least 1–2 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat twice the wash with EtOH 80%.
Air-dry the beads for 10 min at room temperature.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 6 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Transfer 6 μl of the cleared solution into a 0.5 ml Eppendorf RNA/DNA LoBind tube.
Dilute the RA3 adapter in nuclease-free water at a ratio of 1:5 vol./vol.
Add 1 μl of the diluted RA3 adapter to the sample.
Incubate for 2 min at 70 °C with the lid set at 70 °C in a thermo-cycler.
Immediately place the sample on ice after incubation.
Add 4 μl of the following mix: T4 RNA Ligase buffer 10×, 2 μl; T4 RNA Ligase 2, truncated, 1 μl; RNaseOUT™, 1 μl.
Incubate the sample for 1 h at 28 °C in a thermocycler with the lid set at 30 °C.
Transfer the sample on ice after incubation.
Add 3.5 μl of nuclease-free water to the sample.
Prepare a dNTPs mix at 12.5 mM in nuclease-free water.
Add 1 μl of RTP primer to the sample.
Incubate the sample for 2 min at 70 °C in a thermo-cycler with the lid set at 70 °C.
Immediately place the sample on ice after incubation.
Add 5.5 μl of the following reverse transcription mix: 1st strand buffer, 2 μl; dNTPs mix 12.5 mM, 0.5 μl.
Incubate the sample for 1 h at 50 °C in a thermocycler with the lid set at 70 °C.
Transfer the sample into a 200 μl PCR tube.
Add 2 μl of the desired RPI primer to the sample.
Add 35.5 μl of the following PCR mix:
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up-down 5-6 times.
Incubate for 5 min at rt.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
With the sample on the magnetic stand, add 200 μl ice-cold EtOH 80%.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat once the wash in ice-cold ethanol 80%.
Air-dry the beads for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the sample from the magnetic stand.
Resuspend the beads in 20 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 5 min until all the beads have attached to the magnet.
Transfer 17–18 μl of the cleared solution into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf® RNA/DNA LoBind tube.
Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Store the library at –20 °C.
Check 1 μl of library on Bioanalyzer 2100 using a High Sensitivity DNA Kit.
